english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something puzzling or not readily accounted for.
Use this when the reason or meaning is baffling or difficult to understand rather than simply secret.
Use this when something is baffling or makes no sense, often with a hint that it is odd or unreasonable.

examples.english: They suddenly said they wanted to quit; it was inexplicable.
examples.traditional: 佢無啦啦話要辭職，真係莫名其妙。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 waa6 jiu3 ci4 zik1 zan1 hai6 mok6 ming4 kei4 miu6

examples.english: It’s mysterious why they suddenly yelled at me.
examples.traditional: 佢無啦啦鬧我，真係莫名其妙。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 naau6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 mok6 ming4 kei4 miu6

examples.english: Their suddenly yelling at me was completely inscrutable.
examples.traditional: 佢無啦啦鬧我，真係莫名其妙。
